notes.title: New quiz added: European countries and territories flags Quiz.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/2e0c22af412fda0915c0ab99dbf42c0f661ca810.png[/img]

New quiz added: European countries and territories flags Quiz.
[h1]Current state of the game includes 60 questions, (6 themes), each have 4 options.[/h1]

Steam Playtest version has not been yet updated.

[b]Game currently include these challenging quizzes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Caribbean Flag Quiz (10 questions)
[*] All-Stars Ice-Hockey Quiz (10 questions)
[*] Solar System Trivia (10 questions)
[*] General Knowledge Quiz (10 questions)
[*] The Roman Empire Trivia (10 questions)
[*] European Flag Quiz (10 questions)
[/list]

Also couple of improvements added today:

[b]Added an option to return to the main menu after completed 10 questions.[/b]
[i]Cogwheel-icon (access to save game, load game) does not shown in the game for some reason, this bug is been investigated. However you can now access back to the main level after completed the level and choose new Quiz or Trivia, without no need to restart the whole game.[/i]

While adding this option to move to the main menu, we discovered another problem about points calculations. Fix: Needed to create variable to each level to get it work, since if using the same variable on theme 1, points continue to "follow" player to theme 2 etc.

Test your level! Each theme have points calculation system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/517a9565aaf2ed969bea01f1e103a3dd972c39f2.png[/img]

Best regards
Icany

notes.title: Hardcore Trivia EA-version Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/75d24f4f5cba39c7b0761ccd6e4b0db96083e4a0.png[/img]

Hi!

[h1]We have now released Hardcore Trivia EA-version![/h1]

A long await is over! Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

Game currently include these challenging quizzes:

[list]
    [*]Caribbean Flag Quiz (10 questions)

    [*]All-Stars Ice-Hockey Quiz (10 questions)

    [*]Solar System Trivia (10 questions)

    [*]General Knowledge Quiz (10 questions)

    [*]The Rome Empire (10 questions)
[/list]

Each theme include presentation video on starting and in the end and music, which we have specially pick to match the each theme atmosphere. Game is not a boring one ːsteamboredː

[h1]More to come![/h1]

The base game grows to at least 100 question-wide, including at least 10 different themes and interesting DLC-quizzes are added during the development process! What themes would you like to have? Tell us your opinion!

Challenge your brains and have a fun time! Hardcore trivia offers questions for many needs. It's time to test your knowledge! 4 themes: All-Stars ice-hockey Quiz, Caribbean Flags Quiz, Solar System Trivia and General knowledge Quiz! More to come.

The base game grows to at least 100 question-wide, including at least 10 different themes and interesting DLC-quizzes are added during the development process!

Challenge your brains and have a fun time! Hardcore trivia offers questions for many needs. It's time to test your knowledge! 4 themes: All-Stars ice-hockey Quiz, Caribbean Flags Quiz, Solar System Trivia and General knowledge Quiz!

[h1]Current state of the game includes 50 questions (5 themes) and each theme question have 4 options. Can you find the right one?[/h1]

We hope that you will have fun with our game, and we are pretty sure about that. 

Feel free to send any feedback! ːsummer2019flagː

Best regards
Icany

ːsteamthumbsupː

P.S.

[i]In case you are running a school club, bar, restaurant or society, check out our future options for you (Commercial Licence). Commercial Licence has already been enabled, but it includes points calculation system which is not usually suitable if you are running the game to large audience in our Pen & Paper -format. Tailored version for larger audience is coming soon. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40934929/ea31ef0cb62de656581ad0a9c1059f7bc013e12e.png[/img]
